verifier: verify r3 round 1, lens r (regression, budgets, sensitivity, originality), adversarial
head: 4fe1e5714 (units r3 commit 92cfc9adc; GLBs and zone_grades.json in wip sync ad333d298)
method: Own in-game captures on a different seed from the engineer's: max_units_ab --variants all, seed 19 t 420 RIFT High, game camera zoom 28.5, picks A tunlan,dunsom,vashil,ervet,marund / B ardit,ilsheta,lisvel,sukri,odrum / C hesmi,burdam,kemdo,nurrow,ulkro (_harness/_shots/maxunits/vr31_A|B|C; Ulkro was not visible to the viewer team in C). CIELAB median of each crop's dominant hue cluster in a box on the top of the figure. Also compared the engineer's u3_B with v3q_B crops of the same seed and pose. Offline: tri count, mesh, material and texture size of all 6 changed GLBs against ad333d298^, ruling 32 reserved_pct (zone_grade.reserved_pct) on all 16 shipped _base albedos, and a texel diff of old vs new albedo. A perf_1080 --prod seed 11 run was cut by my own timeout at game 790 s (peak 320k at that point) while another verifier held the queue, so I did not reproduce the 506k peak; that figure is the engineer's.

items.verdict: better, but a new team-colour problem
items.evidence: The lilac is gone: at seed 19 Ardit's helm cluster reads L* 66.6 C 24.5 h 253 (dE76 29.0 to Vashil's hood, L 77.5 C 29.8 h 312). But in sRGB the rendered helm is RGB (116,163,194), HSV hue 204 sat 0.40: inside the reserved ally band (200-225) and close to the blue team colour (HP bar and rings, HSV 211). In the crops Ardit's helm reads as the same sky blue as the blue team's markers and blue minions. The albedo is under the cap (ally 3.8 %), but the read at the camera is the thing ruling 32 protects. An enemy Ardit is now led by an ally-blue top.

Hesmi's new hood renders in the purple family: L* 46.6 C 44.0 h 313 and L* 39.0 C 41.3 h 314 (two Hesmi crops, seed 19), against Vashil's hood at h 312 (and 312 in the engineer's u3_A). The hue is the same to within 2 degrees. dE76 is 34-40 only because of the value gap. verify3_q's fix asked to keep crowns out of the 290-330 h family and to move one of Vashil and Dunsom out of lilac. Instead a fourth fighter, a second hooded one, joined it. Two purple-hooded casters (Vashil, Hesmi) now differ only in value at the game camera.

items.verdict: worse (undisclosed change to the face, sensitivity risk, crown not visible)
items.evidence: The claim says the mask is untouched. The texel diff says 35.0 % of Odrum's albedo changed, and the honey mask is among it: the harm-band desaturation to s 0.25 turned the honey-gold mask, hands and pots into bone-ivory (scratchpad odrum_face.png, the face UV island old vs new). A bone-white mask with dark slit eyes moves toward the skull / blank-face family the sensitivity rules ban, and it was the cards lane's open blocker area (Odrum Shadeprint mask). In game (u3_B vs v3q_B, same pose) the whole figure goes from honey to washed grey-cream, the olive cap is not readable, and the top still reads pale cream (seed 19 cluster L* 65.8 C 28.4 h 79). He lost his signature honey and gained no crown. Harm 7.93 % holds the cap by 0.07 points.

Seed 19: the cowl reads as a deep red-brown at L* 32.5 C 23.2 h 52, which is a clear break from the cream of round 2. Harm is 7.62 %. The head and mask texels are unchanged by the diff (2.83 % of texels changed).
Ilsheta's hood reads mint-green in game, but it is pale under the camera's light. Ervet's pink-magenta crest reads, but in this seed's crop it is small. No regressions found.
Both are still lilac-topped. The critic's 'one of them leaves lilac' was not done, and now Hesmi sits in the same hue too.

All 6 changed GLBs have tris, mesh and material counts identical to ad333d298^ (ardit 21149, burdam 20448, ervet 16996, hesmi 19883, ilsheta 18272, odrum 19544), texture sizes are identical (base 2048, normal and ORM 512/256), and the GLBs are 1137-1162 KiB.

The engineer's own perf_1080 has seed 11 at 506k tris, over the 500k hard gate. The task said to pay back if possible, and that was not done. My max_units_ab frames read 248-287k / 179-187 draws / 39 programs, but those are not peaks. The tree also has another workflow's uncommitted src/sim edits (controller, pick, bodypath, movement, nav), so match peaks are not comparable between runs. Programs sit at 40 of 40 in the match.
Harm on the shipped _base: dunsom 16.46 %, ulkro 12.77 %, both over 8 %; everyone else is <= 7.93. These two are not zoned this round and are not a regression, but the cap is not met roster-wide.
These are albedo recolours with no shape change. Nothing is copied.

problems.what: Hesmi's new crown is in the same hue as Vashil's hood (h 313-314 vs 312 in game). This adds a second purple-hooded fighter to the lilac/purple family the critic asked to break up, and they differ only in value.
problems.evidence: _harness/_shots/maxunits/vr31_C/all_fighter_hesmi_1.png, vr31_B/all_fighter_hesmi_8.png vs vr31_A/all_fighter_vashil_3.png (seed 19); u3_C/hesmi_8 vs u3_A/vashil_3 (seed 43).
problems.fix: Move Hesmi's hood out of 290-330 h (for example a deep teal-ink, or rust if the harm cap allows), and move Vashil or Dunsom out of lilac.

problems.what: Odrum: the claim that the mask is untouched is false. The ruling 32 desaturation turned the honey mask, hands and pots bone-ivory. A pale bone mask with slit eyes is a skull or blank-face sensitivity risk, and Odrum lost his signature honey. The olive cap does not read at the game camera, so the crown is still pale cream.
problems.evidence: The texel diff shows 35.0 % of the albedo changed; the face UV island goes honey to ivory. u3_B vs v3q_B all_fighter_odrum_5.png; seed 19 top cluster L* 65.8 C 28.4 h 79.
problems.fix: Hue-shift the band instead (honey toward ochre-olive below HSV 28 or above 50) or exclude the mask from the desaturation, and make the cap larger or brighter in chroma so it reads. Have the cards lane re-check the mask with card_qa.

problems.what: Ardit's new crown renders in the reserved ally hue band and matches the blue team colour (HSV 204 vs the team blue 211). Team-colour readability regresses: an enemy Ardit is led by an ally-blue top.
problems.evidence: vr31_B/all_fighter_ardit_1.png helm median RGB (116,163,194); the HP bar in vr31_B/all_fighter_ilsheta_2.png is RGB (63,156,255).
problems.fix: Pull the helm to h 240-255 in sRGB terms (indigo or ink-blue, HSV >= 228) or to a gunmetal value break, and gate the rendered HSV against the ally band, not only the albedo share.

problems.what: The lane is still below par against the gauge, carried over. 73 of 120 crown pairs fail the engineer's own gate. Vashil and Dunsom are still lilac-twinned. U6 glass, U1(2) ORM and U7 head modelling are not done.
problems.evidence: The engineer's deferred list and u3_units_post.json.

problems.what: Budget: seed 11 match peak is 506k triangles, over the 500k hard gate (engineer's run), and no payback was attempted.
problems.evidence: The implementer's measures. My run could not finish (queue contention), and the tree carries other uncommitted sim edits.
problems.fix: Pay back about 10k in the actor LODs, or confirm the peak on a clean tree at the idle gate.

problems.what: Ruling 32 is not met roster-wide: Dunsom harm 16.46 %, Ulkro 12.77 %.
problems.fix: The lead should rule on scope, or zone-grade both.

verdictSummary: FAIL, 6.9. Ardit has left lilac, but he now renders in ally blue. Hesmi's crown break lands in Vashil's hue. Odrum's mask was changed while the report says untouched, and it moves toward bone-white. The every-pair gate is not met, and seed 11 is over the triangle budget.
